title: project.extract plan
description: What each carrier holds, the objects the plan would create, and the digest that authorizes writing them. A carrier the toolkit cannot enumerate is reported as such rather than skipped: a plan that quietly covered less than it was asked to would read as complete.

carriers.description: One entry per source considered, in id order.

kind.description: `hunk` needs no extraction — the whole-file object already is the object. `lha` and `adf` enumerate. `adf_non_dos` has no filesystem to walk, so it enumerates nothing and reports what the non-executing scans found instead.

detail.description: Why a carrier enumerated nothing, when it did not.

objects.description: Every object the plan would add to the sources document, in id order.

path.description: Where the bytes are materialised, relative to the project root. The object's selector is what reproduces it, so this file can be deleted and re-made.
